entry.name: RoCo Task Board Assembly
entry.title: RoCo Task Board Assembly Demonstrations
entry.venue: RoCo Challenge @ IROS 2026 training data (no paper)
entry.summary: Real-robot demonstrations of industrial task-board assembly on Sharpa's North robot with two 22-DoF Sharpa Wave hands, with a 6-axis force/torque reading plus deformation and raw tactile video from each of the 10 fingertip sensors at 30 Hz.
entry.hand: Sharpa Wave (22 DoF) x 2 on Sharpa North (two 7-DoF arms + 7 torso/motor joints)

sensor.note: Same sensor output as SharpaDex. Per frame: observation.tactile (60,) float32 = (left, right) x (thumb, index, middle, ring, little) x (fx, fy, fz, tx, ty, tz), unit not stated; observation.images.tactile_deform, one 480x1200 video tiling 10 deformation maps of 240x240; observation.images.tactile_raw, one 480x1600 video tiling 10 raw sensor-camera images of 320x240. In the 9 episodes checked, thumb, index and middle carry the contact (per-episode fz maxima 4.4-43.2 in the 8 with contact); ring and little stay near 0.
sensor.model: Sharpa Wave fingertip tactile sensor (Dynamic Tactile Array)
sensor.range: 0-30 N detection, 50 N maximum load (maker spec, Sharpa Wave W01 page)

scale.text: Repo: 3,252 episodes, 11,569,502 frames @30 fps (~107 h), 162 seasons from 4 stations, Jun-Sep 2026, one task (task-board assembly; median episode 105 s). Card: 30 seasons, 562 episodes, 2,461,024 frames

entry.access: Hugging Face SharpaIT/RoCo_TaskBoardAssembly, ungated, ~1.6 TB (LeRobot v3.0 and v2.1 copies per season), one LeRobot root per season folder; the challenge's Google-form registration is for competition updates and is not needed to download.
caveats: Fingertips only (10 sensors); no palm or phalanx touch. Ring and little fingertips stay near 0 in all 9 episodes checked.
Tactile units are not stated ('tactile force/torque signal', fx..tz). The tile order inside the two tactile videos is not documented.
The card's statistics (30 seasons, 562 episodes) lag the repository, which holds 162 seasons and 3,252 episodes (Oct 2026); season_POC22018_2026_08_19_13_40_06_train has only the v2.1 export.
One task: every episode's language label is the single string 'north ces task'; no subtask or scene annotation.
Episodes are long: 9-746 s, median 105 s; only 4 of 3,252 are 10-60 s.

Collection method is not stated (the card says 'demonstrations'). No observation.state.tcp_pose / action.tcp_pose fields. The 24-D observation.state.tcp is all 0 in the 7 POC22061 and POC22002 episodes checked, but carries arm TCP poses and nonzero force/torque slots (magnitudes up to ~40, unit not stated) in the 2 POC22018 episodes.
The card says the v3.0 videos are 'primarily AV1'; info.json lists H.264 for all 161 v3.0 seasons and the one v3.0 file probed is H.264.

tracking.system: Sharpa Wave hand joint states, 22 per hand
tracking.note: observation.state / action = 65-D: left arm 7, left hand 22, right arm 7, right hand 22, torso/motor 7; observation.state.joint_torque (65, torso dims 0)

tracking.system: arm joint encoders (2 x 7) and joint torques

other: tactile deformation video and raw tactile video (10 fingertips tiled in one frame each)

sources: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SharpaIT/RoCo_TaskBoardAssembly lerobot3.0/meta/info.json, lerobotv2.1/meta/episodes.jsonl and tasks.jsonl of all 162 seasons

https://huggingface.co/datasets/SharpaIT/RoCo_TaskBoardAssembly season_POC22061_2026_06_11_14_29_08_train (v3.0 and v2.1 info.json, modality.json, file listing; v3.0 and v2.1 tactile_deform mp4 headers)
https://huggingface.co/datasets/SharpaIT/RoCo_TaskBoardAssembly 9 v2.1 episode parquets from stations POC22061, POC22018, POC22002 (tactile contact scan)
https://huggingface.co/datasets/Sharpa-Robotics/SharpaDex-v1.0 (for comparison: card, all 495 season names and info.json files)
unconfirmed: Robot: the challenge's Industrial Board Assembly page lists 'Real-robot dataset using Sharpa North: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SharpaIT/RoCo_TaskBoardAssembly' and describes Sharpa North as 'A dexterous hand-based mobile manipulator with two robotic arms and 22-DoF hands'; robot_type in the files is 'north_ces'. The hand model (Sharpa Wave) is inferred from the maker, 22 joints per hand and the sensor output (240x240 deformation maps, 6-axis F/T).

Task-board contents: the challenge page says 'a task board inspired by the NIST task board' with connector insertion, wire routing, screw tightening and battery assembly; the parts on the real Sharpa board are not listed.

Totals summed from the files: v2.1 episodes.jsonl of 162 seasons = 3,252 episodes / 11,569,502 frames (107.1 h at 30 fps); v3.0 info.json of 161 seasons = 3,224 / 11,482,834; per-season v3.0 and v2.1 counts agree. Stations from season names: POC22061 101 seasons / 2,015 episodes, POC22018 40 / 872, POC22002 19 / 343, POC22048 2 / 22; start times 2026-06-11 to 2026-09-10.
Tactile tiles (2 x 5; row 0 left, row 1 right; columns thumb..little) assumed identical to SharpaDex, where the order was read from one deformation frame; not checked on a RoCo frame.
Unit of observation.tactile not stated; magnitudes look like N and N m (per-episode fz maxima 4.4-43.2, torques < 0.6, rest ~0, in 8 episodes with contact).
Head cameras are two streams (head_left, head_right); whether they form a calibrated stereo pair is not stated. Camera models not stated.
HF tag size_categories:10K<n<100K does not match either the card (562 episodes) or the repo (3,252 episodes).

sample.reason: Public, ungated Hugging Face release under CC BY 4.0, which allows redistribution with attribution. v2.1 stores one parquet and six mp4 files per episode. Label the collection 'CC BY 4.0'.

episodes.why: Typical length for the busiest station (median 108 s). Left thumb and index 8.9 / 9.1 s continuous (peaks 20.5 / 14.5); right thumb, index and middle 6.2-7.4 s continuous, 17-35 s in total (peaks 14-26). The 60 s window holds 91 of 125 fingertip-seconds of contact.

Second station. Left thumb and index 4.5 / 4.1 s continuous, 11.6 s in total (peaks 26 / 30); right thumb, index and middle 3.5-3.9 s continuous, 10.5-21.4 s in total (peaks 23-30). Window holds 70 of 76 fingertip-seconds.

Third station, latest month. Left thumb, index and middle 3.5-6.3 s continuous (peaks 15-30); right thumb, index and middle 3.9-5.1 s continuous (peaks 14-48, the highest in the RoCo scan). Window holds 65 of 83 fingertip-seconds.

sample.fetch_estimate: ~550 MB: all 6 v2.1 videos of the 3 episodes are 219 + 167 + 162 MB (tree API sizes), tactile_raw 103 / 73 / 88 MB of that; parquets (3-7 MB) already local from the scan. Re-hosted media: cut to the 60 s windows and re-encode tactile_raw to stay under ~30 MB per episode. Episode JSON: 60 values x 30 Hz x 60 s = 108k numbers, under 2 MB.
sample.rules_applied: One task, so 3 episodes from 3 stations (POC22061, POC22018, POC22002; POC22048 has only 22 episodes) stand in for different scenes. 9 v2.1 episodes scanned. Contact = fingertip |F| above the episode's starting median + 1.0 (release units) for at least 1 s continuous; all 3 picks have 5-6 fingertips in contact for 3.5 s or more, no NaN, timestamps at exactly 1/30 s. 3,247 of 3,252 episodes are longer than 60 s, so each pick is cut to the 60 s window with the most fingertip contact (searched in 0.5 s steps).
